newsitem.title: USA: Pratt Wylce names Schlafler pres/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Pratt Wylce names Schlafler pres/CEO.

text.p: Pratt, Wylce & Lords, Ltd said Monday that it has appointed L. Alan Schafler as its new president and chairman of the board, as part of its ongoing reorganization.
As president he succeeds Timothy Miles, who remains with the company. The position of chairman, said the company, had been vacant.
Schafler, said the comapany, has extensive experience in the field of strategic planning and mergers and acquisitions, and formerly held positions at Elgin National Industries, IBM and Revlon.
Schafler's focus, said the company, will be to build Pratt by acquisition or strategic alliances of firms in the technology sector.
